overview.heading: Structured advisory work for youth-centered institutions.
overview.body: Mohamed supports organizations that work with young people by clarifying priorities, strengthening governance, designing practical systems, and translating participation principles into institutional language.

tabs.summary: Public, civic, and foundation-linked work focused on youth priorities, empowerment, institutional alignment, and education participation.

projects.description: Supports reflection on youth priorities, institutional direction, and programmatic alignment for youth engagement and public-sector responsiveness.
Contributes to youth-centered advocacy and education initiatives focused on access, participation, and human development.

tabs.label: Organizational Development Consultancy

projects.description: Contributed to a learning day on governance, wellbeing, and risk management for mission-driven organizational teams.

projects.projectType: Training System and Curriculum Design Consultant
projects.description: Designed structured training systems and Training of Trainers frameworks to move organizations from ad hoc sessions to sustainable learning pathways.
Supported the development of internal regulations, role clarity, decision-making mechanisms, and operational governance tools.

projects.projectType: Youth Department and Strategic Structuring Consultant
projects.description: Supported the development of dedicated youth departments and connected youth programming to broader organizational strategy and positioning.

projects.projectType: Health Standards and Systems Development Consultant

Provided advisory input on positioning, priorities, governance, and institutional effectiveness for youth-led and mission-driven organizations.
